requirements.title: CALL, defined assignment, defined I/O, and finalization invoke subroutines
requirements.definition: A subroutine is invoked by a CALL statement, defined assignment, defined input/output, or finalization; actual argument expressions are evaluated, arguments are associated, and the subroutine executes.

pending.call-statement-invokes-subroutine: CALL s(x) with x initialized to -7; s assigns 42 to its INTENT(OUT) dummy, and the caller verifies 42.
pending.defined-assignment-invokes-subroutine: Define assignment(=) for a derived type that stores rhs+30; assign value 12 into an object initialized to -1 and verify stored 42.
pending.defined-io-invokes-subroutine: Future defined-I/O fixture uses a dtv subroutine that writes exact marker text "DIO42" to an internal file; source registration records the invocation owner only.
pending.finalization-invokes-subroutine: Future finalization fixture uses a final subroutine that increments a module marker from -5 to 42 as the object finalizes; this packet records the invocation owner only.
pending.subroutine-actuals-evaluated-before-asso: Use an actual expression in a CALL through an explicit interface where bump() sets a counter to 9 and s records the dummy value 9.
pending.subroutine-arguments-associated-before-e: Pass an integer variable 14 to s(dummy) and have s assign marker dummy+28, yielding 42.
pending.subroutine-body-executes: Subroutine body sets a module marker from -8 to 42; caller verifies the exact marker after CALL.

requirements.title: Subroutine completion completes the invoking action
requirements.definition: After the subroutine actions complete, the CALL statement, defined assignment statement, processing of an effective item, or finalization of an object is also completed.

pending.call-completes-after-subroutine: After CALL s(marker), execute a following assignment marker=marker+1; s sets 41, and the final value 42 proves the CALL completed before the next statement.
pending.defined-assignment-completes-after-subro: After defined assignment stores 41, execute a following increment and verify 42.
pending.defined-io-effective-item-completes-afte: Future defined-I/O fixture writes one effective item using a subroutine that emits "41" and then appends "2" after the WRITE completes; internal record "412" observes completion order.
pending.finalization-completes-after-subroutine: Future finalization fixture records final subroutine marker 41 and verifies a following statement changes it to 42 after finalization completes.

requirements.title: Alternate return specifiers may branch to selected labels
requirements.definition: A CALL statement containing alternate return specifiers can branch to one of the indicated statements according to the subroutine action.

pending.alternate-return-branch-to-indicated-lab: Call choose(*100,*200) with marker initialized to -1; choose returns 2, label 200 assigns 42, and label 100 would assign 17. Verify 42 to distinguish the selected alternate.

requirements.title: Elemental subroutine elemental references require conformable array output arguments
requirements.definition: For an elemental reference to an elemental subroutine, at least one actual argument corresponding to an INTENT(OUT) or INTENT(INOUT) dummy shall be an array, all such actual arguments shall be arrays, and all actual arguments shall be conformable.

pending.elemental-subroutine-has-output-or-inout: Positive source control calls an elemental subroutine with an INTENT(OUT) array y initialized to -9 and input array x=[1,2]; verify y=[11,12]. Scalar-only output mutation is a source-control contrast without diagnostic facet.
pending.elemental-subroutine-output-actuals-arra: Use two INTENT(OUT) arrays y and z initialized to [-1,-1] and [-2,-2], verify exact updated arrays. A mutation makes one output scalar only as nonconforming contrast.
pending.elemental-subroutine-actuals-conformable: Positive source control uses all arrays of shape [2] and verifies exact outputs; shape-mismatch mutation remains a program-restriction contrast with no diagnostic facet.
